targetText: Mankind today is living through an acute sexual crisis which is far more unhealthy and harmful for being long and drawn-out.
explanation: Diagnosing the widespread crisis of sexual relationships under capitalism, where traditional moral codes collapse without new liberating ethics being fully established.

targetText: Socialists assure us that sexual problems will only be settled when the basic reorganisation of the social and economic structure of society has been tackled.
explanation: The classical Marxist position: sexual alienation, marital bondage, and gender inequality cannot be resolved in isolation, but depend on transforming the underlying economic base.

targetText: The sexual morality of feudalism developed out of tribal authoritativeness and collective patrimonial life. Under capitalism, the triumphant principles of individualism and exclusive private property destroyed whatever remained of community life.
explanation: Historical materialism applied to morality: each economic epoch (feudalism, capitalism, socialism) constructs its own sexual norms and family forms corresponding to its mode of production.
